title: Formal PvNP: Lean 4 proof-complexity development surface
description:
Umbrella Lean 4 development surface for Quantyra proof-complexity infrastructure: resolution size/width models for explicit Tseitin families, switching and bounded-depth scaffolding, and named imported classical boundaries with explicit firewalls.

For narrow mature theorem surfaces, prefer the curated sibling artifacts formal-resolution-lower-bounds, formal-switching-lemma, and certified-affine-extraction.

Non-claims: this repository does not prove P != NP, P = NP, an NP or circuit lower bound, a Frege/PHP lower bound beyond exactly scoped local theorems or clearly labeled named imports, a general proof-system lower bound, or a general SAT solver.
